name: Fast Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting (FCGS)
definition: An optimization-free, feed-forward compression pipeline for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that compresses representations in a single pass without per-scene finetuning, aiming to reduce compression time from minutes to seconds while maintaining fidelity.
summary: FCGS is an optimization-free, feed-forward compression pipeline for 3D Gaussian Splatting that reduces time from minutes to seconds by using an autoencoder-based structure with a Multi-path Entropy Module.
